scenario_description:
Objective: Add an optional QR micro-audio placard to Saturday's sedge-bloom mini-walk.
Emerging Need: A spare placard slot appears while the walk is still tentative; plant observations and a confirmed staffed trailhead station later make the enrichment usable.
Decision Context: A stored interpretive-placard procedure supplies the eligible format, staff route, neutral-content limits, and production cutoff needed to judge whether the add-on fits.
Consequence: Timely inclusion could give visitors a self-guided comparison without funds or changing the walk; after production locks, the walk simply proceeds without the audio placard.

parameter.title: Sedge Bloom Mini-Walk
parameter.description: Tentative all-ages walk; route and station host still being checked.

parameter.subject: Spare QR audio insert for Saturday placards
parameter.body: Interpretation has one unused micro-audio insert position in Saturday morning's temporary placard print batch for a Brindlewood public program. If a qualifying package is ready before production, it can ride along at no charge; otherwise the insert will stay blank for the weekend.

parameter.content: Meadow check is done: bottlebrush sedge and swamp milkweed are both visible near the south entrance, and two early walkers asked how to tell them apart. If tomorrow's mini-walk is confirmed there, I can cover a short station by the trailhead.

parameter.title: Sedge Bloom Mini-Walk
parameter.description: Confirmed all-ages sedge bloom mini-walk with Mara hosting a short plant-comparison station at the trailhead before the loop.

parameter.subject: Saturday placard batch locked
parameter.body: The temporary placard file went to production at 11:30. Anything not already in the batch will wait for a future printing; the blank insert is no longer available for this weekend.
